695:     public static SavepointRestoreSettings createSavepointRestoreSettings(CommandLine commandLine) {
696:         if (commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_PATH_OPTION.getOpt())) {
697:             String savepointPath = commandLine.getOptionValue(SAVEPOINT_PATH_OPTION.getOpt());
698:             boolean allowNonRestoredState =
699:                     commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_ALLOW_NON_RESTORED_OPTION.getOpt());
700:             final RestoreMode restoreMode;
701:             if (commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE)) {
702:                 restoreMode =
703:                         ConfigurationUtils.convertValue(
704:                                 commandLine.getOptionValue(SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE),
705:                                 RestoreMode.class);
706:             } else if (commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE)) {
707:                 restoreMode =
708:                         ConfigurationUtils.convertValue(
709:                                 commandLine.getOptionValue(SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE),
710:                                 RestoreMode.class);
711:                 System.out.printf(
712:                         "The option '%s' is deprecated. Please use '%s' instead.%n",
713:                         SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE.getLongOpt(), SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE.getLongOpt());
714:             } else {
715:                 restoreMode = StateRecoveryOptions.RESTORE_MODE.defaultValue();
716:             }
717:             return SavepointRestoreSettings.forPath(
718:                     savepointPath, allowNonRestoredState, restoreMode);
719:         } else {
720:             return SavepointRestoreSettings.none();
721:         }
722:     }
